label: Heading, line 2 (blue)
text: The Distance to the Decision Is.

label: Paragraph
text: Data lives in your ERP, your CRM, Excel, HRIS, and a handful of operational systems that don't talk to each other. It gets consolidated into a report. Management reads the report and asks “why?” Finance goes back and investigates manually — pulling the same data apart a second time, days after the decision actually needed to be made.

label: Left lane subtitle
text: Disconnected data. Longer paths. Delayed decisions.

label: Right lane subtitle
text: Connected data. Clear insight. Faster decisions.

label: Closing line, part 1
text: More reporting doesn't close that gap.

label: Closing line, part 2 (blue)
text: A shorter distance between the number and the decision does.

label: Lead paragraph
text: Five stages. One direction: from reporting to continuous decisioning. Every finance function sits somewhere on this curve — the question isn't whether you need more data, it's how fast you can turn what you already have into a decision.

label: Body
text: Month-end close eating 10–15 days. Board packs stitched together the night before. Cash visibility that's stale within a week. Forecasts that don't survive the first bad month.

label: Item 1 body

label: Item 5 body

label: Item 6 body
text: line-item packs that explain why, built for boards and lenders.

label: Item 7 lead

label: Item 7 body
text: Excel-based FP&A live in 2–3 weeks for early-stage teams; Power BI/Tableau-driven planning for growth-stage; full enterprise FP&A for mature and PE-backed platforms (see Digital Transformation if you need the platform stood up first).

label: Paragraph 1
text: After a transformative acquisition tripled its revenue in a year, a fast-scaling, NSE-listed VFX/media group needed consolidated, forecast-ready financials across 5 entities, 3 currencies, and 2 time zones — in time for statutory audit and a planned capital raise. We built the forecasting and scenario-modeling engine that got them there.

label: Closing line
text: Every deliverable answers the question a CFO actually asks — not "what were our numbers," but "what should we do next."

text: Digital transformation for finance: ERP, CRM, and FP&A platform implementation, in-house Finsensor AI software, data warehousing, and real-time BI dashboards.

label: Intro paragraph (the H1 is the hub card headline)
text: Buying enterprise software solves nothing on its own, and a dashboard is only as good as the data feeding it. Digital Transformation covers both halves of that problem: Tools — implementing the ERP, CRM, and FP&A platforms your business actually runs on — and Analytics & Warehousing — turning the data those platforms produce into real-time dashboards and decision intelligence. We're platform-agnostic on the third-party side, and we also build our own, in-house, through our Finsensor AI software.

label: Intro paragraph
text: Third-party platforms, implemented by people who actually use them — not just sell them. Half the value of an ERP, CRM, or FP&A platform gets lost in a bad implementation — a chart of accounts that doesn't match how you actually run the business, a CRM nobody trained the sales team to use, or a forecasting tool configured for data entry instead of real planning. We're platform-agnostic on purpose: we implement whatever's right for your business, not the tool we happen to have a reseller relationship with.

label: Item 1 body
text: Oracle NetSuite, Oracle Fusion, Odoo, Zoho, SAP, QuickBooks, and others, configured around your actual chart of accounts and reporting needs.

label: Item 2 body
text: primarily Salesforce, configured so your revenue and pipeline data actually connects to your financial reporting — the foundation for RevOps and revenue analytics, not just a system of record for sales.

label: Item 3 body
text: Anaplan, Aimplan, Jedox, Prophix, Pigment, Vena, Unit4, PivotXL, and beyond. If your team already has a preferred platform, we work in it.

label: Item 4 lead
text: Our own in-house software — Finsensor AI

label: Item 4 body
text: where a third-party platform doesn't fit, we bring our own purpose-built finance software, developed in-house rather than licensed off the shelf.

label: Item 5 body
text: when no off-the-shelf tool fits the gap, we build bespoke tools instead of forcing a workaround.

label: Item 6 body
text: we don't disappear after go-live; ongoing optimization and troubleshooting as your usage — and your business — matures.

label: Callout
text: Platform-agnostic, on purpose. We don't have a reseller margin riding on which system you choose — our incentive is that it works for you, not that you buy a specific license.

label: Intro paragraph
text: Real-time dashboards that replace the manual board deck. Financial statements are backward-looking by definition. By the time a problem shows up in the P&L, the window to act on it has already closed. This is where that gap closes.

label: Item 1 body
text: Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud/Microsoft Fabric foundations, so the analytics layer on top has clean, reliable data to work from.

label: Item 2 body

label: Item 3 body

text: Deal advisory for CFOs, PE, and VC-backed companies — M&A, buy-side and sell-side due diligence, IPO readiness, debt refinancing, and investor/pitch decks.

label: Intro paragraph (the H1 is the hub card headline)
text: The worst time to discover a gap in your financials is during due diligence, when a buyer, investor, or lead underwriter is already asking the hard questions. Most companies find out their numbers aren't deal-ready exactly when it matters most — mid-transaction, under time pressure, with leverage already shifting away from them.

label: Item 1 body
text: buy-side and sell-side support through diligence, negotiation, and close, from a team that's actually built the models, not just reviewed them.

label: Item 2 body
text: financial due diligence, quality of earnings (QoE) and quality of assets (QoA) analysis, risk assessment, and legal/compliance reviews.

label: Item 3 body
text: getting your financial house in order before you're in a data room: clean historicals, defensible forecasts, and a management pack that survives real scrutiny.

label: Item 4 body
text: the actual decks — fundraise pitch decks, investor updates, and board presentation materials — built on numbers your own diligence-ready models can defend.

label: Item 5 body
text: preparing the financial package and providing negotiation support for a refinancing, so lenders see the same clean, defensible numbers a PE buyer or IPO underwriter would.

label: Item 6 body
text: readiness assessments and reporting infrastructure built to the standard public-market investors and regulators expect.

label: Paragraph 1
text: We've helped a client secure a $525M PE acquisition deal — hands-on support through the numbers that mattered most in the room. And for a fast-scaling, NSE-listed VFX/media group, our platform enabled a ₹85 Cr QIP by cutting five-year financial data retrieval for merchant banker requests from weeks to hours.

label: Closing line
text: Due diligence doesn't wait for you to be ready. We make sure you already are — the numbers and the story.

text: Answers to common questions about GAMCS's FP&A and CFO advisory, finance team extension, digital transformation, deal advisory, and training services.

label: Lead into the Schedule a Call link
Question 1
text: What is FP&A advisory, and how is it different from accounting or bookkeeping?

label: Answer 1
text: FP&A is forward-looking: budgeting, forecasting, scenario modeling, and variance analysis that guide decisions. Accounting and bookkeeping — which we deliver through Finance Team Extension — are backward-looking: recording what already happened and staying compliant. Both matter; they're just different disciplines.

label: Question 2
text: How quickly can GAMCS stand up FP&A for a growing company?

label: Answer 2
text: Our Excel-based FP&A model — standardized financial models, 13-week rolling cash flow, and variance frameworks — typically goes live in 2–3 weeks with minimal dependency on your existing tech stack, and scales into BI dashboards or enterprise FP&A tools as you grow.

label: Question 3
text: What BI, analytics, and RevOps tools does GAMCS use?

label: Answer 3
text: Primarily Power BI and Tableau, connected directly to your ERP, CRM, and HR systems for automated, real-time refresh — including RevOps analytics like CAC, ROAS, and pipeline velocity. Underlying infrastructure runs on Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud/Microsoft Fabric. This is the Analytics & Warehousing arm of our Digital Transformation pillar.

label: Question 4
text: How does Finance Team Extension work for a PE or VC portfolio?

label: Answer 4
text: We build a dedicated, standardized Finance & Analytics Center of Excellence (part of our Finance Team Extension pillar) that embeds offshore teams into each portfolio company, using one consistent KPI framework and chart-of-accounts methodology across the fund. The same pillar also covers lighter-touch staff augmentation and Employer of Record (EoR) arrangements when a full CoE isn't what's needed.

label: Question 5
text: Do you provide due diligence support for M&A, fundraising, or refinancing?

label: Answer 5
text: Yes. We provide financial due diligence, quality of earnings and quality of assets analysis, fundraise/exit-readiness support, and debt refinancing advisory for both buy-side and sell-side transactions — including hands-on support that helped a client secure a $525M PE acquisition.

label: Question 6
text: Do you help prepare investor decks or board presentations?

label: Answer 6
text: Yes. We build investor updates, fundraise pitch decks, and board presentation materials directly — grounded in the same diligence-ready models and real-time dashboards we build for ongoing FP&A and BI work.

label: Question 7
text: Are you tied to specific software vendors?

label: Answer 7
text: No — we're platform-agnostic by design. We implement ERP systems (Oracle NetSuite, Oracle Fusion, Odoo, Zoho, SAP, QuickBooks), CRM platforms (primarily Salesforce), and FP&A tools (Anaplan, Aimplan, Jedox, Prophix, Pigment, Vena, Unit4, PivotXL, among others). Where none of those fits, we also bring our own in-house software, Finsensor AI.

label: Question 8
text: How does GAMCS ensure accuracy and compliance across GAAP standards?

label: Answer 8
text: Our accounting and reporting work is built to Ind AS, US GAAP, and IFRS standards, supported by proprietary tools — including our Consolidation Tool, SIII Reporting Tool (IGAAP & Ind AS), and IFRS 16 / Ind AS 116 lease calculation accelerators — built on our in-house Finsensor AI software. Clients report 100% accuracy in financial records and compliance reporting.

label: Question 9
text: Do you only work with direct clients, or also with other advisory firms?

label: Answer 9
text: Both. Beyond direct corporate and PE/VC clients, we operate as the embedded finance and analytics delivery team behind other advisory firms — including Three Sixty Finance (UK) and Akshar Business Consulting (UK).

label: Question 10
text: Do you offer training, or only client engagements?

label: Answer 10
text: Both. Alongside corporate training and enablement work, our founders teach two public courses through Thinking Bridge — the FP&A Strategy MasterClass and the Tableau MasterClass — and we're associated with the FP&A Professional Institute (FPI).

label: Question 11
text: Who is GA Management Consultants built for?

label: Answer 11
text: CFOs and CXOs at growth-stage and mid-market companies, private equity or venture capital investment teams needing standardized visibility across a portfolio, and advisory firms needing embedded delivery capacity.
